feeds.title: Joanna Henderson
feeds.description: My name is Joanna Henderson and I'm a London based professional photographer specializing in interior photography and still life photography. I work on editorial and commercial shoots and provide stunning and atmospheric mood and lighting to all my interior photography and still life photography.

feeds.title: Wendy Carrig » still life photography
feeds.description: Whether photographing fashion, celebrity or documentary, Wendy Carrig is always looking for the 'story' looking beyond the superficial. Seeking connections & finding empathy with those she photographs. Encouraging emotional response from both subject and viewer alike. A prominent photographer for three decades Wendy Carrig is recognised for her photographs of models, musicians, Olympians & politicians. Her commercial work has been widely published on magazine covers and advertising hoardings, and she has twice won the Association of Photographers GOLD award.

feeds.title: Cristina Colli Blog
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Cristina. I'm an artist, photographer, and teacher in love with creativity, visual storytelling, beauty, flowers, simplicity, and slow living. A photographic stylist and photographer based in the Cotswolds Oxfordshire specialized in still life photography floral photography commercial and editorial.
